# Source manifest and data provenance

## Provenance

**All data in this repository is synthetic and was generated by this project's own code.** No public
dataset, scraped content, third-party text corpus or real customer record was used. Nothing needs a
licence, attribution or redistribution permission.

| Element | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Feedback text | Clause templates written for this project (`generator/text_templates.py`) in English, Hindi and Telugu, in native script and romanised | Products, features, amounts and durations are filled in from seeded random choices |
| Customer names | Curated lists of common Indian first and last names in `text_templates.py` | Combined at random, so they do not correspond to real people |
| E-mails | `firstname.lastname.<n>@example.com` | `example.com` is reserved for documentation (RFC 2606) |
| Phone numbers | Random 10-digit numbers in the Indian mobile format | Fictitious, generated only to exercise privacy detection |
| Products and brands | Invented names (for example "Voltix Smart Plug", "Annapurna Toor Dal 2kg") | Any resemblance to real brands is coincidental |
| Labels | Derived by rule from clause tags (`derive_sentiment`) | Documented in `docs/business_rules.md` |
| Scenario events | `generator/config.py::SCENARIO_EVENTS` | Fictional disruptions used to plant sentiment shifts |

Public data guidance (problem statement): because no external data is used, there are no source URLs,
dataset versions, retrieval dates, licences, transformations or discarded fields to record. If
external data is added later, record those fields in a table here, one row per source.

## Generator

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Generator | `InsightPulse synthetic generator`, version `1.0.0` |
| Seed | `20261022` (fixed) |
| Commands | `python -m generator.generate_data --scale starter --seed 20261022`<br>`python -m generator.generate_data --scale full --seed 20261022` |
| Determinism | Each stream (customers, reviews, support, anomalies...) has its own `random.Random(f"{seed}:{stream}")`, so changing one stream never shifts another. Output files are written in a stable order and encoding (UTF-8, `\n` line endings). |
| Configuration | Recorded in full in each `manifest.json` (`config`): volumes, date range, language mix, sarcasm, ambiguity and suggestion rates, theme-count weights, split shares, anomaly rates |
| Checksums | SHA-256 of every generated file in `data/exports/<scale>/checksums.json` |
| Reproducibility evidence | `data/exports/<scale>/reproducibility_report.json` (`python -m scripts.check_reproducibility`) |

## Generated files

Every table is written as both CSV and JSON.

| Directory | Contents | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `data/master/<scale>/` | channels, products, customers, surveys, themes, sentiment_labels | ingestion |
| `data/raw/<scale>/` | reviews, survey_responses, support_tickets, support_messages, ticket_status_events, annotations (TRAIN/VALIDATION labels), dataset_splits | ingestion, training |
| `data/ground_truth/<scale>/` | `evaluation_set` (human-reviewed TEST labels), `ground_truth` (injected anomaly registry), `scenario_events` | **only** `evaluation_service` (token-protected) |
| `data/exceptions/<scale>/` | rejected_records.csv, validation_summary.json, file_validation.json, validation_reconciliation.json | review |
| `data/exports/<scale>/` | manifest, checksums, evaluation report, reproducibility report, probe report, enriched feedback, actions, DQ issues (CSV/JSON), data-only SQL seed | delivery |
| `data/probe/` | `free_text_probe.csv`: 30 hand-written out-of-template sentences | `scripts/free_text_probe.py` |

The full dataset is about 150 MB uncompressed, so it is not committed in that form. It can be
regenerated byte for byte with the command above; `checksums.json` lets you verify this. A zipped
copy is committed in `data/exports/full/`.

## Transformations applied downstream

1. Ingestion derives `feedback_items` from the three source tables. It copies the customer, product,
   channel, date and rating, normalises whitespace and computes `text_hash`. Agent messages are not
   feedback items.
2. Validation never edits source text. When personal data is found, a redacted copy goes in
   `feedback_items.redacted_text`; the raw text stays in the source table for audit.
3. Training drops out-of-taxonomy theme labels from each annotation, and annotations excluded by
   validation are not used. The only model feature is the text.
